chunks.arabic_text: الكَافِي: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ:

translations.en: Al-Kafi: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Muawiya ibn Wahb who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

chunks.arabic_text: إِنَّ عِنْدَ كُلِّ بِدْعَةٍ تَكُونُ مِنْ بَعْدِي يُكَادُ بِهَا الْإِيمَانَ وَلِيٌّ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِي مُوَكَّلٌ بِهِ يَذُبُّ عَنْهُ، يَنْطِقُ بِإِلْهَامٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَيُعْلِنُ الْحَقَّ وَيُنَوِّرُهُ، وَيَرُدُّ كَيْدَ الْكَائِدِينَ، يَعْبُرُ عَنِ الضُّعَفَاءِ فَاعْتَبِرُوا يَا أُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ وَتَوَكَّلُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ.

translations.en: For every innovation that arises after me – by which is sought the weakening of the faith – there will be a guardian from the people of my house in charge of it who will defend it, he will speak by inspiration from Allah and will proclaim the truth and illuminate it, he will repulse the plot of the plotters and speak out in defense of the weak ones, so pay heed O possessors of insight and rely upon Allah.

en.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines the doctrine of the Imams from the Prophet's household as divinely appointed guardians who counteract religious innovations (bid'ah) after the Prophet's death. It describes their role in defending the faith through divine inspiration, proclaiming the truth, repelling the schemes of opponents, and advocating for the weak, serving as a source of insight and reliance for believers.
en.seo_question: What is the role of the Ahl al-Bayt in combating religious innovation according to this hadith?

key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِي: The People of My House (Ahl al-Bayt)
key_terms.الضُّعَفَاء: The weak (those unable to defend themselves)
